notes: Bryan Boilers, distinct from Bryant (separate brand, separate file). The decodable value is the 6-character Bryan NUMBER on the data plate, not a serial number; the page states the year can alternatively be read from the 'Year Built' line on the plate. No month is encoded in the Bryan number, so this ships year-only. Page names Burnham, Crown, New Yorker, Thermal Solutions, Thermo Pride and U.S. Boiler as sister/similar brands; shared-system use by them is not established by this page, so no sisters claim is made and no usesStylesOf is set.

styles.notes: Page example 040132 with the 04 prefix highlighted; page positions 1-2 (1-based) = year, converted to [0,2]. Century rule resolves '04' to 2004 only (1904 is below the 1960 floor). Bryan numbers before 1960 correctly yield no match under this rule rather than a guessed year.
